shawshank.title: The Shawshank Redemption
descriptions: A banker convicted of killing his wife gets a life sentence. He does the guards' taxes, builds a prison library and spends twenty years patiently chipping at a wall with a tiny rock hammer.
A poster on a cell wall hides more than it seems. A story about hope that bars cannot take away.

green_mile.title: The Green Mile
descriptions: A death row guard in the 1930s meets a gentle giant of an inmate who can heal with a touch. A trained mouse lives in the cell block too.
A prison officer realizes the giant awaiting execution is innocent and gifted with a miracle. But the machine is already in motion.

forrest_gump.title: Forrest Gump
descriptions: A kind man with a low IQ tells strangers at a bus stop about his life: Vietnam, ping-pong, a shrimp business and running across America. Life is like a box of chocolates.
A good-hearted man keeps stumbling into the biggest moments of half a century of American history, while loving one girl his whole life.

intouchables.title: The Intouchables
descriptions: A paralyzed Parisian aristocrat hires a young man from the projects as his caregiver, though he only came for a signature for his benefits. Soon they race a Maserati and dance to Earth, Wind & Fire.
A rich man who cannot move and a poor man with nothing to lose teach each other how to live. A French comedy based on a true story.

schindler.title: Schindler's List
descriptions: A German industrialist and Nazi party member spends his fortune saving over a thousand Jews by listing them as workers at his factory. Shot in black and white, except for a girl in a red coat.
An entrepreneur who started out for profit turns his own business into a way of saving lives during the Holocaust.

interstellar.title: Interstellar
descriptions: Earth is dying from dust storms, and a former pilot flies through a wormhole near Saturn to find humanity a new home. On a planet near a black hole, one hour equals seven years.
A father leaves his daughter to save her future and tries to send her a message through a bookshelf.

leon.title: Léon: The Professional
descriptions: A quiet hitman in New York drinks milk, cares for a houseplant and unexpectedly protects a 12-year-old neighbor whose family was murdered by a corrupt cop.
A lonely hired gun teaches a girl his trade, and she teaches him how to be human.

lion_king.title: The Lion King
descriptions: A treacherous uncle arranges the ruler's death in a wildebeest stampede, and the young heir runs off to the jungle, where a meerkat and a warthog teach him a carefree life — hakuna matata.
An heir who believes he is to blame must return home and take his place in the circle of life.

fight_club.title: Fight Club
descriptions: An insomniac office worker meets a charismatic soap salesman. Together they start underground brawls in a bar basement. The first rule is not to talk about them.
A man tired of catalog furniture and an empty life finds a radical new friend. Too radical.

back_future.title: Back to the Future
descriptions: A teenager is accidentally sent 30 years into the past in a DeLorean built by an eccentric scientist. Now he must get his parents to fall in love, or he will fade away.
To get home, the hero needs 1.21 gigawatts and a lightning strike on the clock tower.

matrix.title: The Matrix
descriptions: A hacker learns that the everyday world is a computer simulation and real humans sleep in pods run by machines. He is offered a choice: the blue pill or the red pill.
An office programmer spends his nights searching for an answer to a question he cannot put into words. Bullets freeze in midair.

titanic.title: Titanic
descriptions: A poor artist wins a ticket on a luxury liner in a poker game and falls for a high-society girl. In April 1912 the ship hits an iceberg.
An elderly woman tells treasure hunters about a love story that lasted only a few days and ended in icy water.

inception.title: Inception
descriptions: A professional thief steals secrets from dreams. His new job is not to steal an idea but to plant one, going into a dream within a dream within a dream. The top on the table keeps spinning.
A city folds in half and gravity goes mad. The real question is whether what you see is real.

godfather.title: The Godfather
descriptions: The aging head of an Italian-American mafia family loses his grip, and power unexpectedly passes to his youngest son — a war hero who wanted nothing to do with the family business. A horse's head in a bed.
An offer you can't refuse. A saga of a family where loyalty and crime cannot be separated.

pulp_fiction.title: Pulp Fiction
descriptions: Two hitmen discuss what burgers are called in France, the boss's wife dances the twist, a boxer runs off with the money and something glows inside a briefcase. The stories are shuffled in time.
Several Los Angeles tales of gangsters, robbers and pure chance, told out of order.

spirited_away.title: Spirited Away
descriptions: A ten-year-old girl wanders into the spirit world, where her parents have turned into pigs. To save them, she takes a job at a witch's magical bathhouse and starts forgetting her own name.
A Japanese anime about growing up in a world where a faceless spirit eats gold and a train runs across the water.

home_alone.title: Home Alone
descriptions: A big family flies to Paris for Christmas and forgets their eight-year-old son. The boy turns the house into an obstacle course for two hapless burglars.
A kid who wished his relatives would disappear gets his wish and learns he misses them. Traps, an iron and paint cans.

ivan_vasilievich.title: Ivan Vasilievich Changes Profession
aliases: Ivan Vasilievich: Back to the Future
descriptions: An inventor builds a time machine: a fearsome 16th-century tsar lands in a Moscow apartment, while a building manager and a burglar end up in the tsar's palace.
A Soviet comedy based on a Bulgakov play: an autocrat is terrified of a car, and a timid official receives foreign ambassadors.

diamond_arm.title: The Diamond Arm
descriptions: A modest economist returns from a cruise, and smugglers mistakenly hide gold in the plaster cast he wears after a fall. Now the gang is desperate to get the cargo back.
A Soviet citizen on a sea voyage accidentally becomes a courier for criminals and helps the police catch them.

irony_fate.title: The Irony of Fate
aliases: The Irony of Fate, or Enjoy Your Bath!
descriptions: After a bathhouse visit with friends on December 31, a Moscow surgeon mistakenly flies to Leningrad. There he finds the same street, the same building and a key that opens a stranger's apartment.
A New Year's story about how identical apartment blocks and pure chance can sometimes lead to love.

operation_y.title: Operation Y and Other Shurik's Adventures
descriptions: Three short stories about a bespectacled student: he re-educates a bully at a construction site, studies for an exam with a girl and guards a warehouse targeted by three comic crooks.
A Soviet comedy about a polite student who keeps landing in absurd situations.

brother.title: Brother
descriptions: A young man fresh out of the army comes to St. Petersburg to join his older sibling, a hitman, and soon starts shooting himself. He loves the rock band Nautilus Pompilius and believes strength lies in truth.
The 1990s. A quiet young veteran finds his place in a criminal city.

moscow_tears.title: Moscow Does Not Believe in Tears
descriptions: Three girls from the provinces come to the capital in the 1950s seeking happiness. Twenty years later, one of them, a single mother, runs a factory and meets a mechanic on a commuter train.
An Oscar-winning Soviet melodrama about success and loneliness. Life begins at forty.

gentlemen_fortune.title: Gentlemen of Fortune
descriptions: A kindergarten director is the spitting image of a dangerous thief. The police send him to a prison camp to find out from the gang where Alexander the Great's helmet is hidden.
A kind teacher re-educates hardened criminals as if they were children.

white_sun.title: White Sun of the Desert
descriptions: A Red Army soldier crossing Central Asia on his way home after the Civil War is forced to guard a bandit's harem. A customs officer refuses bribes because he feels for his country.
A Soviet "Eastern" that cosmonauts traditionally watch before a launch. The East is a delicate matter.

meeting_place.title: The Meeting Place Cannot Be Changed
descriptions: Post-war Moscow. A seasoned police captain and a young frontline veteran hunt down the Black Cat gang. A thief belongs in prison!
A miniseries about two detectives who disagree on whether it's fine to plant evidence when the suspect is surely guilty.

office_romance.title: Office Romance
descriptions: To get a promotion, a timid economist with two kids starts courting the stern head of a statistics bureau, whom her staff secretly mock.
A Soviet comedy about how a career woman with no private life and a quiet clerk find each other.

dawns_quiet.title: The Dawns Here Are Quiet
descriptions: 1942, Karelia. A sergeant major and five young anti-aircraft gunners head into the forest to stop sixteen German saboteurs.
A war drama based on Boris Vasilyev's novella about young women who had to fight instead of living.

stalker.title: Stalker
descriptions: A guide leads a Writer and a Professor through the forbidden Zone to a Room that grants one's innermost wishes. They test the path by throwing metal nuts.
A slow parable about faith and desire, loosely based on the Strugatsky brothers' Roadside Picnic.

heart_dog.title: Heart of a Dog
descriptions: A professor transplants a dead drunkard's organs into a stray mutt, and the animal becomes a man — rude, thieving and very ideological. Never read Soviet newspapers before dinner!
A black-and-white Bulgakov adaptation about a scientific experiment on nature and on society.

hachiko.title: Hachi: A Dog's Tale
descriptions: A professor finds an Akita puppy at a train station and takes him home. The loyal Akita meets his owner off the train every day and keeps coming to the station for years.
An American remake of a Japanese story about loyalty stronger than time.

prestige.title: The Prestige
descriptions: Two magicians in Victorian London compete for years, each trying to crack the secret of the Transported Man trick. One of them turns to Nikola Tesla.
Every magic trick has three acts. The last one is worth sacrificing everything for.

shutter_island.title: Shutter Island
descriptions: 1954. Two U.S. marshals arrive at a psychiatric hospital off the Massachusetts coast to investigate a missing patient. A storm hits, cutting them off from the mainland.
A detective who grows less sure of his own memory the closer he gets to the truth.

gladiator.title: Gladiator
descriptions: A Roman general refuses to serve the new emperor, who murdered his own father. His family is executed, and he is sold into slavery and forced to fight in the Colosseum.
A general became a slave, a slave became a fighter, and the fighter defied an emperor. What we do in life echoes in eternity.

lotr_return.title: The Lord of the Rings: The Return of the King
descriptions: Two hobbits make their way through Mordor to Mount Doom, while their friends defend Minas Tirith and lead an army of the dead. The trilogy finale that won 11 Oscars.
The last chapter of an epic saga: the heir to the throne accepts the crown, and a small hero carries a heavy burden to the end.

harry_potter_1.title: Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone
aliases: Harry Potter and the Sorcerer's Stone
descriptions: An orphan lives in a cupboard under the stairs until, on his eleventh birthday, he learns he is a wizard. Platform nine and three-quarters leads to a school of magic.
First year at a castle where staircases move, portraits talk and chess can be deadly.

terminator2.title: Terminator 2: Judgment Day
descriptions: A cyborg that once hunted the mother of the future resistance leader now protects her teenage son from a new model made of liquid metal. Hasta la vista, baby!
The future is not set. A machine learns why humans cry.

silence_lambs.title: The Silence of the Lambs
descriptions: An FBI trainee asks an imprisoned cannibal psychiatrist to help catch a serial killer. In return, he wants her to tell him about her childhood.
A thriller in which the scariest conversation takes place through the glass of a cell. One of the few films to win all five top Oscars.

amelie.title: Amélie
descriptions: A shy waitress from Montmartre finds a box of childhood treasures hidden in her apartment wall and decides to secretly make other people's lives better. A garden gnome travels the world.
A French fairy tale about a young woman who arranges everyone else's happiness but fears her own.

pianist.title: The Pianist
descriptions: A famous Polish-Jewish musician survives in occupied Warsaw, hiding in abandoned buildings. One day a German officer finds him.
The true story of a man saved by music when his whole world vanished.

catch_me.title: Catch Me If You Can
descriptions: In the 1960s a teenager poses as an airline pilot, a doctor and a lawyer while forging millions of dollars in checks. An FBI agent spends years on his trail.
A cat-and-mouse game between a charming con man and a stubborn investigator, based on real events.

wall_e.title: WALL·E
descriptions: A small trash-compacting robot has been cleaning an abandoned Earth for centuries, until he meets a sleek white probe robot. For her, he travels into space.
Almost wordless: a love story between two machines and about people who forgot how to walk.

up.title: Up
descriptions: An elderly widower ties thousands of balloons to his house and floats off to South America, not noticing a young scout on his porch.
An animated film whose first ten minutes tell an entire life. Then come talking dogs and a rare bird.

coco.title: Coco
descriptions: A Mexican boy dreams of becoming a musician, though music is banned in his family. On the Day of the Dead he enters the colorful land of his ancestors.
An animated film about memory: as long as you are remembered, you exist. Remember me.

howl.title: Howl's Moving Castle
descriptions: The Witch of the Waste turns a young hatter into an old woman. She finds shelter in the walking home of a vain wizard, where a fire demon lives.
An anime about war, curses and love, based on a novel by Diana Wynne Jones.

joker.title: Joker
descriptions: A failed comedian with a nervous laugh works as a party clown in Gotham and lives with his sick mother. The city slowly drives him to madness. A dance on the stairs.
The origin story of the most famous comic-book villain, told as a social drama.

parasite.title: Parasite
descriptions: A poor Korean family from a semi-basement flat, one by one, gets hired by a rich household: as a tutor, an art therapist, a driver and a housekeeper. The house has a secret of its own.
The first non-English-language film to win the Oscar for Best Picture. About stairs, smells and social class.

green_book.title: Green Book
descriptions: 1962. A bouncer from the Bronx is hired to drive a Black piano virtuoso on a concert tour of the Deep South. They carry a travel guide for Black motorists.
A road comedy about the friendship of two very different men, fried chicken and dignity.

truman.title: The Truman Show
descriptions: An insurance salesman doesn't know he has lived inside a giant studio since birth and that his life is broadcast around the clock. A spotlight falls from the sky.
In case I don't see ya: good afternoon, good evening and good night. A man who wanted to see the edge of his world.

twelve_angry.title: 12 Angry Men
descriptions: Jurors decide the fate of a teenager accused of killing his father. Eleven are sure he is guilty, and only one has doubts. Almost the whole film takes place in one stuffy room.
A black-and-white drama about reasonable doubt proving stronger than prejudice.

dark_knight.title: The Dark Knight
descriptions: Gotham's masked vigilante teams up with an idealistic district attorney against a chaotic criminal with a scarred grin who burns a mountain of cash just to watch the world burn.
The hero the city deserves, but not the one it needs right now. A story of chaos testing how far decent people will go.

godfather2.title: The Godfather Part II
descriptions: Two stories in one: a young Sicilian immigrant builds a criminal empire in early-1900s New York, while decades later his son tightens the family's grip in Cuba and Nevada, losing those closest to him.
A sequel to a mafia saga that many consider better than the first film. Power grows while the family falls apart.

star_wars_4.title: Star Wars: Episode IV – A New Hope
descriptions: A young man from a desert farm finds a droid carrying a secret message from a princess and, with an old Jedi and a smuggler, sets out to destroy a moon-sized battle station.
A long time ago in a galaxy far, far away… The start of a famous space saga about the Force and its dark side.

jurassic_park.title: Jurassic Park
descriptions: A billionaire clones dinosaurs from ancient DNA preserved in amber and invites scientists to his island attraction. During a storm, the power goes out.
Life finds a way. Ripples in a glass of water warn of trouble.

jaws.title: Jaws
descriptions: A huge great white shark attacks swimmers off a resort island. The police chief, an oceanographer and an old fisherman head out to sea to hunt it. You're gonna need a bigger boat.
Two notes of music, and nobody wants to go in the water anymore. The film that started the summer blockbuster.

indiana_raiders.title: Raiders of the Lost Ark
descriptions: An archaeology professor in a fedora with a bullwhip races the Nazis for a sacred relic. It opens with him fleeing a giant rolling boulder.
A scholar who is afraid of snakes and nothing else. 1930s adventure in the spirit of old movie serials.

saving_ryan.title: Saving Private Ryan
descriptions: After the Normandy landings, a captain and his squad are ordered behind enemy lines to find a paratrooper whose three brothers have been killed. It opens with the storming of Omaha Beach.
Is a single soldier's life worth the lives of eight? A war drama about duty and the price of an order.

avatar.title: Avatar
descriptions: A marine in a wheelchair gets a ten-foot blue body and travels to the jungle moon Pandora, where a corporation mines a valuable mineral. He falls for a woman of the Na'vi tribe.
The highest-grossing film of its time, shot in 3D. Floating mountains and trees that remember.

alien.title: Alien
descriptions: The crew of a commercial space tug answers a signal from an unknown planet. One astronaut comes back with a creature on his face, and soon a hunt begins on board.
In space no one can hear you scream. Science fiction that turns into a horror film.

pirates_caribbean.title: Pirates of the Caribbean: The Curse of the Black Pearl
descriptions: An eccentric captain without a ship teams up with a blacksmith to rescue the governor's daughter from a crew that turns into skeletons in the moonlight.
Rum, a compass that doesn't point north and an undead crew. A film based on a Disneyland ride.

lotr_fellowship.title: The Lord of the Rings: The Fellowship of the Ring
descriptions: A young hobbit inherits a dangerous heirloom from his uncle and leaves the Shire with a wizard, an elf, a dwarf and two men on a long journey. The first film of the Tolkien trilogy.
Nine travelers, a single burden and a bridge where a grey wizard declares: You shall not pass!

avengers_endgame.title: Avengers: Endgame
descriptions: After a villain wiped out half of all life in the universe with a snap of his fingers, the surviving superheroes try to undo it through time travel.
The 22nd film of a huge comic-book universe and a long farewell to its heroes. I love you 3000.

seven.title: Se7en
descriptions: An old detective about to retire and his young partner investigate a series of murders in a rainy city, each punishing a deadly sin. What's in the box?
A grim thriller where the worst thing happens not on screen but in a package delivered to the desert.

departed.title: The Departed
descriptions: Boston. A young cop goes undercover in the Irish mob while a mob plant rises through the police. Each is hunting for the rat in his own ranks.
A remake of a Hong Kong thriller that finally won its director an Oscar. Two double agents and one woman.

wolf_wall_street.title: The Wolf of Wall Street
descriptions: A young New York stockbroker starts a firm selling penny stocks and drowns in money, parties and drugs until the FBI comes for him. Sell me this pen.
The rise and fall of a financial fraudster, told by the man himself without a drop of remorse.

django.title: Django Unchained
descriptions: A German bounty hunter buys an enslaved man's freedom, and together they ride south to rescue his wife from a cruel plantation owner.
A spaghetti western about revenge in pre-Civil War America. The D is silent.

inglourious.title: Inglourious Basterds
descriptions: During World War II a squad of Jewish-American soldiers terrorizes the Nazis, while a Paris cinema owner plans her revenge at a propaganda film premiere.
Alternate history in which the war is decided by nitrate film in a movie theater. Dialogue in four languages.

kill_bill.title: Kill Bill: Vol. 1
descriptions: A bride in a yellow tracksuit wakes from a coma and takes a samurai sword to the former assassin colleagues who gunned down her wedding.
Revenge is a dish best served cold. A bloody mix of kung fu, anime and western, told in two volumes.

one_flew.title: One Flew Over the Cuckoo's Nest
descriptions: A small-time criminal fakes insanity to get out of prison labor and lands in a psychiatric ward, where he challenges the icy head nurse.
A rebellion against a system that cures with obedience. A giant silent patient and a heavy marble water fountain.

rain_man.title: Rain Man
descriptions: A cocky car dealer learns his father left his fortune to an autistic brother he never knew existed. They drive across America, counting toothpicks and cards in Las Vegas.
A road trip in which a selfish hustler learns to care for someone. Four Oscars, including Best Picture.

beautiful_mind.title: A Beautiful Mind
descriptions: A brilliant Princeton mathematician develops a theory of equilibrium, then starts seeing conspiracies and people who aren't there. The Nobel Prize comes decades later.
The true story of a scientist who spent years telling reality from hallucination by sheer logic.

pursuit_happyness.title: The Pursuit of Happyness
descriptions: A single father with a little son sleeps in subway restrooms and shelters, sells bone-density scanners and takes an unpaid internship at a brokerage firm.
A true story of poverty, stubbornness and a Rubik's Cube solved in a taxi.

dead_poets.title: Dead Poets Society
descriptions: A new English teacher at a strict boys' prep school teaches his students to think for themselves, stand on their desks and seize the day — carpe diem.
O Captain! My Captain! A drama about a freedom the grown-ups aren't ready to give.

ghost.title: Ghost
descriptions: A banker is murdered in the street, but his spirit stays near the woman he loves to protect her. Only a fraudulent psychic can help him. The famous pottery wheel scene.
A love that doesn't end with death. Unchained Melody and a clay vase.

pretty_woman.title: Pretty Woman
descriptions: A wealthy businessman hires a girl from Hollywood Boulevard to accompany him to society events for a week. Shopping on Rodeo Drive: Big mistake. Huge!
A modern Cinderella in Beverly Hills, named after a Roy Orbison song.

snatch.title: Snatch
descriptions: London gangsters, an underground bare-knuckle boxer, a Russian with a gun and a dog that swallowed a squeaky toy all chase a huge stolen diamond.
A criminal merry-go-round where nobody understands what the traveller says, yet everyone wants a stone the size of a fist.

gentlemen.title: The Gentlemen
descriptions: An American who built an underground marijuana empire beneath aristocrats' estates in England decides to sell, and a hunt begins. The story is pitched as a screenplay by a cheeky private eye.
Tweed suits, a pig farm and a boxing coach with rapping students. Manners are armor.

big_lebowski.title: The Big Lebowski
descriptions: An unemployed slacker who loves bowling and White Russians is mistaken for a millionaire with the same name. Thugs ruin his rug, and he gets dragged into a strange kidnapping case.
That rug really tied the room together. A cult comedy about staying mellow in an uptight world.

mad_max_fury.title: Mad Max: Fury Road
descriptions: In a post-apocalyptic desert, a one-armed warrior steals an armored truck carrying a tyrant's wives, and a drifting ex-cop helps them escape. An army of roaring vehicles with a flame-throwing guitarist gives chase.
Nearly the whole film is one long chase there and back. Six Oscars and hardly any dialogue.

shining.title: The Shining
descriptions: A writer takes a job as the winter caretaker of a snowbound mountain hotel with a dark past, bringing his wife and son. The boy rides his tricycle down empty hallways and meets twin girls.
Hundreds of pages of the same sentence. A Stephen King adaptation the author himself disliked.

casablanca.title: Casablanca
descriptions: During World War II a cynical American nightclub owner in Morocco meets his former love, who must escape the Nazis together with her husband, a Resistance leader.
Play it again. A Hollywood classic where a farewell on a foggy airfield is the beginning of a beautiful friendship.

some_like_hot.title: Some Like It Hot
descriptions: Two Chicago musicians witness a gangland massacre and escape to Florida disguised as women in an all-female band. A millionaire starts courting one of them.
Well, nobody's perfect. A black-and-white comedy starring Marilyn Monroe and a ukulele.

gone_wind.title: Gone with the Wind
descriptions: The headstrong daughter of a rich Georgia planter survives the Civil War, ruin and three marriages, yet loves the wrong man all her life.
After all, tomorrow is another day. A four-hour epic that won eight Oscars.

groundhog.title: Groundhog Day
descriptions: An arrogant TV weatherman comes to a small town for a festival and gets stuck in time: every morning it's February 2 again, and the alarm clock plays the same song.
The same 24 hours lived thousands of times until a cynic learns to be kind.

mask.title: The Mask
descriptions: A shy bank clerk fishes an ancient wooden artifact out of a river and, putting it on, becomes a green-faced cartoon maniac in a yellow suit who wins over a singer and outwits gangsters.
Smokin'! A comedy where the hero's face follows the laws of cartoons, and the dog wants in on the fun.

men_in_black.title: Men in Black
descriptions: A New York cop is recruited by a secret agency that polices aliens living on Earth. The agents wear dark suits and wipe witnesses' memories with a flashing device.
A giant bug wearing a farmer's skin and a galaxy on a cat's collar. A comedy about very strange neighbors on our planet.

die_hard.title: Die Hard
descriptions: A New York cop arrives at his wife's Christmas party in a Los Angeles skyscraper just as robbers seize it. Barefoot, in a tank top and armed with a radio, he takes on the gang alone.
Yippee-ki-yay! Christmas movie or action movie — an argument that still hasn't ended.

fifth_element.title: The Fifth Element
descriptions: 23rd-century New York. A cab driver and ex-commando catches a red-haired girl who falls from the sky into his car; she holds the key to saving Earth from a great evil. A blue-skinned opera diva sings.
Multipass! A colorful space fairy tale with flying cars and costumes by Jean-Paul Gaultier.

taxi_fr.title: Taxi
descriptions: A Marseille speed demon in a white Peugeot souped up for racing helps a clumsy cop who can't drive catch a gang of German robbers in Mercedes cars.
A French comedy whose real star is a car with a pop-up spoiler. Written by Luc Besson.

knockin_heaven.title: Knockin' on Heaven's Door
descriptions: Two terminally ill young men meet in a hospital, steal a Mercedes with a gangster's million in the trunk and head for the sea they have never seen.
Up there, all anyone talks about is the sea. A German road movie about a last wish.

life_beautiful.title: Life Is Beautiful
descriptions: A cheerful Jewish-Italian waiter is sent to a concentration camp with his little son and convinces the boy it's all a game where points can win a real tank.
Comedy and tragedy in one film: a father who invents a fairy tale to save his son. Three Oscars.

cinema_paradiso.title: Cinema Paradiso
descriptions: A famous Roman director returns to his Sicilian village for the funeral of the old projectionist who taught him to love movies as a boy. The local priest had every kiss cut from the films.
Nostalgia for a movie house where a whole village laughed, cried and fell in love. A reel of censored kisses.

slumdog.title: Slumdog Millionaire
descriptions: A young man from Mumbai's slums is arrested for cheating: he is one question away from the top prize on an Indian quiz show. He knows each answer from a moment in his own life.
It is written. Eight Oscars and a dance on a train platform over the end credits.

grand_budapest.title: The Grand Budapest Hotel
descriptions: An impeccable concierge at a luxurious mountain resort in a fictional Alpine country and his young lobby boy get caught up in the theft of a painting and a fight over an inheritance.
A pastel-pink fairy tale about a Europe that vanished. Patisserie boxes and a prison break.

social_network.title: The Social Network
descriptions: A Harvard programming student builds a site for rating classmates in one night, then a service that will connect billions of people. Meanwhile, two lawsuits with former friends unfold.
You don't get to 500 million friends without making a few enemies. Aaron Sorkin's dialogue and a Trent Reznor score.

gone_girl.title: Gone Girl
descriptions: On their fifth anniversary a wife vanishes from their Missouri home, and every clue points to her husband. The press makes him the prime suspect, while her diary tells another story.
The perfect couple everyone knew everything about, except the truth. A thriller about marriage as a public performance.

benjamin_button.title: The Curious Case of Benjamin Button
descriptions: A boy is born in New Orleans as a frail old man and grows younger every year. He lives a century in reverse and shares only a brief time with the woman he loves, when their ages meet.
A station clock runs backward, and a life starts from the end. Based on an F. Scott Fitzgerald story.

cast_away.title: Cast Away
descriptions: A delivery company employee survives a plane crash and spends four years alone on a desert island. His only companion is a volleyball with a face painted on it.
A package that was never opened and a friend lost to the waves. A film about making fire and keeping your sanity.

devil_prada.title: The Devil Wears Prada
descriptions: A journalism graduate with no interest in fashion becomes the second assistant to the tyrannical editor-in-chief of a glossy magazine. The job demands an unpublished Harry Potter manuscript and her personal life.
A monologue about a cerulean sweater that explains the entire fashion industry. That's all.

bohemian_rhapsody.title: Bohemian Rhapsody
descriptions: The son of immigrants from Zanzibar, working as a baggage handler at Heathrow, becomes the frontman of a British rock band with operatic ambitions. The climax is 20 minutes of Live Aid at Wembley.
Six minutes with no chorus that nobody wanted on the radio. A biopic of a voice known around the world.

toy_story.title: Toy Story
descriptions: A pull-string cowboy, a boy's favorite, grows jealous of a new space ranger with wings and a laser. When the kid isn't looking, everything in the bedroom comes alive.
The first feature-length film made entirely on computers. To infinity and beyond!

shrek.title: Shrek
descriptions: A green swamp-dwelling hermit strikes a deal with a short lord: he'll rescue a princess from a dragon's castle, and the fairy-tale creatures will be evicted from his land. A chatty donkey tags along.
Ogres are like onions — they have layers. A fairy tale that makes fun of fairy tales.

finding_nemo.title: Finding Nemo
descriptions: A timid clownfish father crosses the ocean to rescue his son, taken by a diver to a dentist's aquarium in Sydney. A fish with short-term memory loss helps him.
Just keep swimming. Surfing sea turtles and sharks who have sworn off fish.

monsters_inc.title: Monsters, Inc.
descriptions: A furry blue scarer and his one-eyed green partner work at a factory that powers their city with children's screams. One day a little girl slips into their world through a closet door.
Creatures who are terrified of children. Closet doors leading to bedrooms all over the world.

inside_out.title: Inside Out
descriptions: Five emotions — Joy, Sadness, Anger, Fear and Disgust — run the mind of an eleven-year-old girl who has moved to San Francisco. Two of them get lost in the maze of memory.
An animated film about why we need sadness. Islands of personality and an imaginary friend made of cotton candy.

ratatouille.title: Ratatouille
descriptions: A rat with a refined nose dreams of becoming a chef and secretly cooks in a Paris restaurant by steering a clumsy kitchen boy, tugging his hair under his toque.
Anyone can cook. A stern critic and one dish from childhood that melts the ice.

incredibles.title: The Incredibles
descriptions: A former superhero banned from saving the world is bored at an insurance company. A secret mission on an island drags his whole family into adventure: a stretchy wife, an invisible daughter and a speedy son.
No capes! A spy story about family values and a midlife crisis.

zootopia.title: Zootopia
descriptions: The first rabbit police officer in a huge city of animals teams up with a sly fox con artist to find missing predators. Sloths run the vehicle registration office.
A detective story about prejudice told as a cartoon. Anyone can be anything.

frozen.title: Frozen
descriptions: The queen of Arendelle accidentally traps her kingdom in eternal winter and flees to the mountains. Her younger sister follows with an ice harvester, a reindeer and a snowman who loves summer.
Let it go! A fairy tale where true love isn't a prince's kiss.

how_train_dragon.title: How to Train Your Dragon
descriptions: The scrawny son of a Viking chief, instead of killing a winged beast, befriends an injured Night Fury. He builds it a prosthetic tail fin and teaches his village to live in peace with fire-breathing neighbors.
An island where fire-breathing beasts steal sheep. A friendship that begins when nobody kills anybody.

kung_fu_panda.title: Kung Fu Panda
descriptions: The chubby son of a noodle shop owner dreams of martial arts and unexpectedly becomes the chosen Dragon Warrior. A tiny red master trains him while five animal fighters look down on him.
There is no secret ingredient. Dumplings, endless temple steps and a wise old tortoise.

beauty_beast.title: Beauty and the Beast
descriptions: A bookish girl from a French village agrees to stay in an enchanted castle in place of her father. Its master is a cursed prince, and his servants have become a candlestick, a clock and a teapot.
A rose under a glass dome is losing its petals. The first animated film nominated for the Best Picture Oscar.

aladdin.title: Aladdin
descriptions: A street thief from Agrabah finds a magic lamp, and a fast-talking genie grants him three wishes. To win a princess he poses as a prince, while a scheming vizier wants the lamp for himself.
A flying carpet and a song about a whole new world. The genie is voiced by Robin Williams.

totoro.title: My Neighbor Totoro
descriptions: Two sisters and their father move to a country house while their mother is in the hospital. In the forest they meet a huge furry spirit who flies on a spinning top and rides a cat bus.
Waiting for a bus in the rain with an umbrella for a forest giant. The emblem of Studio Ghibli.

mononoke.title: Princess Mononoke
descriptions: A young prince cursed by a demon boar travels west and finds himself caught between an ironworks town and the gods of the forest. A girl raised by wolves fights for the forest.
A war between people and the forest with no villains. A deer god by day and a giant by night.

your_name.title: Your Name
descriptions: A Tokyo schoolboy and a girl from a mountain village start swapping bodies in their sleep. They leave notes on each other's hands until they realize a comet, not just distance, separates them.
A red cord, twilight and someone you're searching for without remembering why. An anime that broke Japan's box-office records.

hedgehog_fog.title: Hedgehog in the Fog
descriptions: A little prickly creature sets off one evening to visit his bear cub friend, count stars and drink tea with raspberry jam. On the way he gets lost in thick white mist and sees a white horse.
Ten minutes often named the greatest animated film of all time. A white horse in the mist.

bremen_musicians.title: The Bremen Town Musicians
descriptions: A troubadour, a donkey, a dog, a cat and a rooster travel in a wagon giving street shows. The young man falls for a princess and steals her away from the royal castle, while forest robbers get in the way.
A Soviet animated rock musical loosely based on a Brothers Grimm tale.

prostokvashino.title: Three from Prostokvashino
descriptions: A serious city boy moves to the countryside with a talking cat and dog. The village postman brings them parcels, and the cat buys a cow and dreams of a tractor.
Put the sausage tongue-side down for a tastier sandwich. A Soviet cartoon about freedom based on Eduard Uspensky's story.

winnie_pooh_su.title: Vinni-Pukh
descriptions: A teddy bear with sawdust in his head floats up on a balloon to a hollow tree for honey, then gets stuck in Rabbit's burrow after eating too much.
A Soviet take on an English classic, with the bear voiced by Yevgeny Leonov.

kid_karlson.title: The Kid and Karlsson
descriptions: A lonely Stockholm boy dreams of a dog, and through his window flies a plump little man with a propeller on his back who loves jam and buns. The strict housekeeper doesn't believe he exists.
A man in his prime who lives on the roof. A Soviet adaptation of Astrid Lindgren.

snow_queen_su.title: The Snow Queen
descriptions: A shard of a magic mirror lodges in a boy's eye and heart, and an icy ruler takes him to her northern palace. His friend follows barefoot, past a sorceress's garden and a robbers' den.
The word Eternity spelled out in ice. A Soviet Andersen adaptation that inspired Miyazaki.

paddington.title: Paddington
descriptions: A polite little bear from the Peruvian jungle arrives in London and is taken in by a family who finds him at a railway station. He loves marmalade, and a villainous taxidermist is after him.
If we're kind and polite, the world will be right. A bear in a blue duffel coat and a red hat.

jumanji.title: Jumanji
descriptions: Two kids find an old board game with drums in an attic: every roll unleashes lions, monkeys or a flood on the town, and out comes a grown man who spent 26 years in the jungle.
Roll the dice and fear the consequences. A game you can't quit until someone reaches the end.

charlie_chocolate.title: Charlie and the Chocolate Factory
descriptions: A boy from a poor family finds a golden ticket in a candy wrapper and joins four spoiled children on a tour of an eccentric confectioner's works, staffed by tiny Oompa-Loompas.
A river of cocoa, nut-sorting squirrels and gum that turns a girl into a blueberry. A Roald Dahl adaptation.

prisoner_caucasus.title: Kidnapping, Caucasian Style
descriptions: A student of folklore travels to a southern mountain region to collect toasts and legends, while a local official hires three bumbling crooks to abduct a pretty student so he can marry her.
I feel sorry for the little bird! A Leonid Gaidai comedy whose song about polar bears the whole country sang.

twelve_chairs.title: The Twelve Chairs
descriptions: A former marshal of the nobility and a charming con man hunt for his mother-in-law's diamonds, sewn into one piece of a dining set scattered across the country.
The ice has broken, gentlemen of the jury! Ilf and Petrov's satire about a treasure hunt in 1920s Russia.

afonya.title: Afonya
descriptions: A slacker plumber in a provincial town drinks, cuts corners and doesn't notice that a young nurse is in love with him. When he finally visits his home village, the aunt who raised him has passed away.
A sad comedy about a man nobody waits for except the people he never notices.

mimino.title: Mimino
descriptions: A Georgian helicopter pilot from a mountain village dreams of flying big jets and goes to Moscow. At a hotel he shares a room with an Armenian truck driver, and together they get into all sorts of trouble.
A comedy about how there's no place like home, even after you've flown abroad.

kin_dza_dza.title: Kin-dza-dza!
descriptions: A Moscow foreman and a violin student press a button on a tramp's gadget and land on a desert planet where matches are worth a fortune and everyone squats and says Koo! in greeting.
Social rank by the color of your trousers and a rusty flying barrel. A dystopia played as comedy.

autumn_marathon.title: Autumn Marathon
descriptions: A Leningrad translator rushes between his wife and his young mistress, lying to both, while his Danish neighbor drags him out jogging every morning.
An intellectual who can't say no. A sad comedy starring Oleg Basilashvili.

i_walk_moscow.title: Walking the Streets of Moscow
descriptions: A young Siberian writer spends a day in the capital and befriends two young men and a girl from a record shop. A light summer day full of chance encounters.
A film with almost no plot whose real heroine is the Soviet capital in the summer of the 1960s.

garage.title: Garage
descriptions: Members of a research institute's car-park cooperative lock themselves in a hall overnight to decide whom to expel: a new road is coming and there isn't room for everyone.
One meeting, one night and the whole Soviet intelligentsia in miniature. A satire by Eldar Ryazanov.

beware_car.title: Beware of the Car
descriptions: A modest insurance agent steals vehicles from bribe-takers and black marketeers, sells them and sends the money to orphanages. His friend, a police investigator, acts alongside him in an amateur theater.
A Soviet Robin Hood played by Innokenty Smoktunovsky. Hamlet on an amateur stage.

cruel_romance.title: A Cruel Romance
descriptions: A Volga town in the 19th century. A dowerless girl from an impoverished family falls for a dashing shipowner but agrees to marry a poor clerk. Gypsy songs and a steamboat.
An adaptation of Alexander Ostrovsky's play about a girl without a dowry.

station_two.title: Station for Two
descriptions: A pianist who missed his train gets stuck in a provincial railway restaurant, quarrels with a feisty waitress and falls in love. He is on his way to a prison camp, taking the blame in someone else's place.
A love story caught between trains. An accordion at dawn by a prison fence.

carnival_night.title: Carnival Night
descriptions: Young staff at a House of Culture plan a cheerful New Year's Eve party, but their boring acting director wants to turn it into lectures and fables. A song about five minutes.
Is there life on Mars? Science doesn't know. Eldar Ryazanov's first comedy and Lyudmila Gurchenko's breakthrough.

hussar_ballad.title: Hussar Ballad
descriptions: 1812. A young noblewoman disguises herself as a cornet and goes to war against Napoleon, fighting beside the lieutenant she was meant to marry, who doesn't recognize her.
A musical comedy based on the play A Long Time Ago that became a New Year classic. A cavalry maiden.

love_doves.title: Love and Pigeons
descriptions: A village man who keeps birds gets a holiday trip to the Black Sea and has a resort romance with an eccentric office woman, while his wife and three kids wait at home.
A beloved Soviet comedy about family, a seaside resort and coming home.

seventeen_moments.title: Seventeen Moments of Spring
descriptions: February 1945. A Soviet spy posing as an SS officer in Berlin tries to thwart secret Nazi peace talks with the Western Allies. A wordless meeting with his wife in a café.
Information to consider. A black-and-white miniseries that emptied the streets of a whole country.

musketeers_su.title: D'Artagnan and Three Musketeers
descriptions: A young Gascon arrives in Paris, challenges a trio of royal guardsmen to duels on his very first day and becomes their friend. Together they save the queen's honor by bringing her diamond pendants back from England.
A swashbuckling Soviet musical starring Mikhail Boyarsky.

sherlock_su.title: Sherlock Holmes and Dr. Watson
descriptions: A retired army surgeon rents a room on Baker Street from Mrs. Hudson and becomes the partner of a brilliant detective with a violin and a pipe. Leningrad streets stand in for Victorian London.
Elementary! A Soviet Conan Doyle adaptation that British viewers called one of the best.

that_munchausen.title: That Very Munchausen
descriptions: The famous fibbing baron who rode a cannonball and pulled himself out of a swamp by his own hair wants a divorce to marry the woman he loves. Society declares him mad, since he always tells the truth.
Smile, gentlemen, smile! Grigory Gorin's parable about a man who refused to lie.

ordinary_miracle.title: An Ordinary Miracle
descriptions: Out of boredom, a wizard turns a bear into a young man who will become a beast again if a princess kisses him. The young man meets a princess, and both are afraid of love.
Yevgeny Schwartz's fairy tale about love stronger than fear. A tyrannical king and a weary wizard played by Oleg Yankovsky.

formula_love.title: Formula of Love
descriptions: A famous Italian sorcerer and adventurer, a count, arrives in the Russian countryside promising to bring a statue to life. His servant runs off with a village girl while the local gentry entertain the guest.
Uno, uno, uno momento! A comedy about how magic is a fraud, but feelings are not.

mary_poppins_su.title: Mary Poppins, Goodbye
descriptions: A strict, magical nanny floats down by umbrella to two London children on Cherry Tree Lane and promises to stay until the wind changes.
A practically perfect lady and songs by Maxim Dunayevsky. A Soviet musical based on P. L. Travers' books.

guest_future.title: Guest from the Future
descriptions: A Moscow fifth-grader finds a time machine in an abandoned house and ends up at the end of the 21st century, where space pirates are hunting a young girl and a mind-reading device.
Beautiful faraway, don't be cruel to me. A children's miniseries whose heroine the whole country fell in love with.

electronic_adv.title: The Adventures of Electronic
descriptions: A professor builds a robot identical to a sixth-grader, and it escapes from the lab. The boy it looks like talks the robot into going to school for him, while crooks plan to kidnap it.
Winged swings flying high. Two twins: one real, one not.

pokrovskie_vorota.title: The Pokrovsky Gates
descriptions: Moscow in the 1950s. A communal flat houses an ex-wife with her new husband and her ex-husband, plus a young student, while a variety singer lives next door. Everything gets tangled up.
A nostalgic comedy about a communal apartment, a motorcycle and old Moscow.

adventures_italians.title: Unbelievable Adventures of Italians in Russia
descriptions: An old woman dying in a Rome hospital confesses she hid a treasure under a lion in Leningrad. Her grandson, a doctor, an orderly and a mobster race to the USSR, helped by a local guide.
A rising drawbridge, a live lion in a car and a chase down a snowy highway. A Soviet-Italian co-production.
